title: 경기도 안양시와 광명시의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:32533:20220315:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 경기도 안양시와 광명시의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정
full_text:
ADDENDUM <No. 32533, March 15, 2022>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force upon the expiration of 30 days from the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Administrative Dispositions, etc.) (1) Public notifications, dispositions, or other acts made before this Decree enters into force by the head of a former local government or the head of an agency affiliated therewith with respect to an area incorporated into another local government shall be deemed public notifications, dispositions, or other acts made by the head of the local government or the head of its affiliated agency that acquires jurisdiction over the relevant area pursuant to this Decree.
(2) Applications, reports, or other acts filed with or performed before the head of a former local government or the head of an agency affiliated therewith before this Decree enters into force shall be deemed applications, reports, or other acts filed with or performed before the head of the local government or the head of its affiliated agency that acquires jurisdiction over the relevant area pursuant to this Decree.

Article 3 (Relationship with Other Statutes or Regulations) Where any statute or regulation in force when this Decree enters into force defines all or part of a Si whose jurisdiction is altered by this Decree as a jurisdictional area, the area altered by this Decree shall, until that statute or regulation is amended following the enforcement of this Decree, be deemed to belong to the jurisdictional area of the former local government for the purpose of applying that statute or regulation.
